draftNote: 1 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Cuban Noobster (midlane→carry).

coaching.headline: A 21-5 objective count — the game was won in the lanes and closed through Genesis Core at 21.
coaching.team: Four lane reads were favored and all four delivered — their mid Rampage went 2/5, Kwang 0/5, Revenant 4/4 — and the majors went 21-5. The leak worth naming even in a 22-minute win: six won fights, zero cashed, and they quietly took the 11 and 17-minute Fangtooths, the second falling across the map while we won the 17.3 fight. Cleaner pit timing turns this into an even faster close.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Phase's opening double kill at 1.2 set the tone, and the lane control that followed turned even-item fights into a 7-1 tower count.

perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster's Belica beat the odd mid-Rampage matchup flat — kills on him at 5.9 and 7.4 with 20813 hero damage on a clean 2/2/5. The one note is 11.6: ahead in lane while a 0-2 went down at their Fangtooth; the shove-and-rotate flips that fight.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim opened the game with a double kill — Zinx and Rampage inside the first 80 seconds — and finished 4/3/6 with 9,256 healing on Phase. The two mid-game deaths at 10.6 and 16 were the priced ones; each preceded a Fangtooth going to them.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs lost the lane read and won the lane anyway: after the 5.4 catch by Khaimera he went untouched, closing 6/1 with three kills on Khaimera and a 16.1-to-21.9 finishing spree — the line of the night.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Kwang Surge of the Heavens (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Lash Kick gap-close+slow → Windburn %hp basics → Backlash push, Quelling Gale to disengage
ourKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks grant attack speed
ourKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick
ourKits.playAgainst: she wants 1v1s — group and burst her; Quelling Gale only stops projectiles

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

enemyKits.combo: Pounce → Rumble slow → Boulder Throw → Behemoth ult to brawl
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Pounce, grow with Behemoth and out-sustain the fight
enemyKits.passive: ramping health regen for jungle sustain
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he front-lines and CCs
enemyKits.playAgainst: anti-heal and kiting beat his sustain brawl; burst him before Behemoth

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
enemyKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

enemyKits.combo: Judgement tether → Surge knockup → Fury of the Heavens slow, recall the blade
enemyKits.winCondition: tether a target, knock up and brawl with energized basics
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he tethers and knocks up
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait his blade-recall mobility, then punish when it's placed

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
enemyKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 22 minutes, fewer deaths than about 85% of Aurora jungle players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Cryoseism at rank 2: 125s base, about 74.4s by the end (40% shorter) from 68 ability haste: Spirit Of Amir 10, Flux Matrix 15, Dynamo 10, Tempest 8, ultimate haste 25.
Aurora dealt 16,972 hero damage, 19% of their team's, with +210 magical power from items.

Penetration: Spirit Of Amir 7, Wraith Leggings 11; against Kwang (level 13: about 51 magical armor, 33 after penetration; took 3,823 magical damage from heroes, 24% of all hero damage they took) and Zinx (level 11: about 39 magical armor, 21 after penetration; took 3,202 magical damage from heroes, 31% of all hero damage they took) that is about 13% and 15% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Spirit Of Amir (item): Abilities deal 12% more damage to Monsters.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Flux Matrix (item): Nearby Enemy Heroes: Take 10% additional Magical Damage. Have their Tenacity decreased by 50%.
Dynamo (item): On Immobilizing an Enemy: They take 8% more damage for 2.5s.
Tempest (crest): Deal 15 (+15%) Damage to 3 nearby Heroes every second for 7s. Heal equal to 35% of the damage dealt. Additional hits against the same Target deal 20% Damage.
Vesh (Eternal): Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% a minute, about 15.8% by the end) of that damage as a DoT over 3s.
The Tenth Seal (Eternal minor): At Level 10, gain 5% Ultimate Damage and 25 Ultimate Ability Haste.
Millennia (Eternal minor): Every 60s, increase your Ultimate Ability Damage by 0.75%.

Sustain: Tempest: Deal 15 (+15%) Damage to 3 nearby Heroes every second for 7s. Heal equal to 35% of the damage dealt. Additional hits against the same Target deal 20% Damage.; 6,953 healing recorded.
Toughness: +900 health, +30 physical armor, +45 magical armor; took 22,068 damage, mitigated 15,121, died 1 times.

Loadout augment Frozen Fury: Frost Storm grants 10-34% Attack Speed while active. Increases with Hero Level. [10-34% by level: about 29.8% at level 15] Field: 48.4% in 670 games, 18% of picks, below the hero-role's 51.3%.

Loadout Eternal Vesh: Ability damage dealt to Enemy Heroes deals 7% (+0.4% per minute) of that damage as a DoT over 3s. [7% growing 0.4% a minute: about 15.8% by the end (22 min)] Field: 51.8% in 625 games, 17% of picks, level the hero-role's 51.3%.
Loadout minor The Tenth Seal: At Level 10, gain 5% Ultimate Damage and 25 Ultimate Ability Haste. Field: 52.3% in 155 games, 25% of picks, above the hero-role's 51.3%.
Loadout minor Millennia: Every 60s, increase your Ultimate Ability Damage by 0.75%. Field: 52.3% in 107 games, 17% of picks, above the hero-role's 51.3%.

Loadout crest Tempest: Overcharge:  Deal 15 (+15%) Damage to 3 nearby Heroes every second for 7s. Heal equal to 35% of the damage dealt. Additional hits against the same Target deal 20% Damage. Field: 49.9% in 1468 games, 40% of picks, below the hero-role's 51.3%.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Spirit Of Amir, Wraith Leggings, Vesh. Aurora has 3 damaging abilities (Boreal Sweep, Hoarfrost, Cryoseism hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 43 ability haste brought them back 30% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Spirit Of Amir, Tempest.
The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (The Tenth Seal + Millennia) sits on the same trigger as the items (every ability hit set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 0 of the 4 players Aurora killed built magical armor. No anti-heal on the team against a build that heals. We killed Aurora 1 time.
Copy it? Vesh: 51.8% in 625 Aurora jungle games, level with the hero's 51.3%. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.

card.lesson: Cryoseism came back about every 74s instead of 125s by the end (40% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.
